description: Implementation of a generic SRS estimator for wireless communication, including phase shift compensation, channel estimation, and time alignment based on received resource grid data.

classes.name: srs_estimator_result
classes.description: Structure holding the results of the SRS estimation, including channel matrix, noise variance, RSRP, EPRE, and time alignment.

classes.name: srs_channel_matrix
classes.description: Data structure representing the estimated channel matrix with coefficients for each RX and TX port.

methods.name: handle_validation
methods.description: Checks the validity of the configuration and fills an error message if invalid.

methods.name: compensate_phase_shift
methods.description: Applies phase shift compensation to the mean least squares estimate based on subcarrier phase shift and offset.

methods.name: estimate
methods.description: Main function to estimate channel parameters, time alignment, and noise characteristics from resource grid data and configuration.
